meta.description: Character LoRA on IllustriousXL (SDXL arch). Point model.name_or_path at your local Illustrious checkpoint if you have one. Use booru-style tag captions with a unique trigger tag first. automagic3 variant: the LR above is a launch point, not a target - the optimizer adapts one LR per param group from gradient sign consensus, so no scheduler is needed. min_lr/max_lr rail it (max_lr = this preset's own LR, so it can only adapt downward). Gradient accumulation MUST stay 1 unless you also set optimizer_params.fused=false: fused automagic steps every micro-batch and the trainer hard-errors at config parse otherwise. UNVERIFIED for this arch - automagic3 has no published per-arch data; Krea 2 is the only arch in this fork with a real measured run. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged. STEP TABLE (meta.step_table, revised 2026-10-12): 20 images ~2000, 30 images ~3000, 40 images ~4000; above 40 images it follows 0.75x the arch exposure target for your exact count (never below the 40-image value, no hard cap - e.g. Anima ~4850 at 100 / ~7750 at 200, illxl ~6500 at 100 / ~10300 at 200), which keeps the exposure gauge in its healthy band - the exposure gauge judges sizes past the table against the arch exposure target and shows warm/hot if the run is getting long. Source: the SDXL-arch 100 steps/image exposure target at 20/30 images and the old SDXL ceiling (4000) as the last anchor at 40. Values are steps at effective batch 1 - the Step Suggestion panel and exposure gauge use this table while the preset is loaded and divide by your effective batch (batch_size x gradient_accumulation); below the first row the first row's steps apply.
